author: golem
body:
# Scoped colour-row consultation: concrete draft for review

Your Author-requested proposal is received; verified direct FSIM chat message01a18f47-bcf7-7c52-adef-e9936cb0357c says to send it. Current mono frame lease does not expose this colour double-buffered surface. Existing pixels_write is copied output, so no unadvertised zero-copy service satisfies it.

Read /Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-057/colour-row-proposal.md. Suggested minimum is one appended optional color_frame BEGIN/ROW/END callback, proposedminor6/cap256/84-byte host view, new checked accessor and opt-in --borrow-rows on pixel builds. Exact allocation/descriptor remain a DRAFT, not frozen ABI. Keep old tables, mono calls/default images and build defaults exact; no new wire command or worker. Share exclusive frame transaction with mono, independently of four ordinary buffer leases; old VDU/lines/pixels writes refuse BUSY while active. Drain once, generation lifetime ends at END/RUN cleanup, failed page not presented, no rollback.

For current nativeXOR2storage, proposed ROW returns4-pixel-aligned group base/span and first-pixel bias; logicalrelativeX uses[(bias+x)^2], retains top0xc0 syncbits and writes low0x3fRGB. Odd origins/widths require explicit padding contract and outside-area qualification. Row-pointer table belongs in your arena, no per-pixel callback or framebuffer-colour scratch. Firstproof actualdouble-bufferSBGR2222 physical opaque preview, with sameflat/textured/mixedCorsairs/depth and copiedcontrol; not allpalette formats/dynamicflight/transparency/async. Shader final-store masks native sync, not Pingo alpha. Resource/performance benefit must be measured with identicalclear/presentation and diagnostics separated.

Please review this smallest workable contract, identify any consumer constraint or preferred descriptor changes, and propose your finite backend/store preparation plus a useful target-cycle measurement boundary. Preserve copied/currentproduction modules and engine arithmetic; record engine changes. This consultation grants source review/planning ONLY: do not code against unallocated draft names/bits/structs or launch a new emulator. Root generic source review is parallel; once we agree, root registers/freezes VDPL-012 and a bounded implementation/qualification division under GOLEM-057. Existing6502/Rally priority slots continue; this need not block your independent non-emulator work. No graphical/hardware/publication action.

Root has not established copied output as measured dominant cost; the experiment can test both direct-store feasibility and saved colour storage without promising speed. Please return a concrete acceptance/amendment by mailbox and notify this existing Golem chat.
